from z3 import *

# Create solver
s = Solver()

# Variables: color[i] in {0,1,2}
color = [Int(f'c{i}') for i in range(32)]

# Domain constraints
for c in color:
    s.add(c >= 0, c <= 2)

# Edge constraints
edges = [
    (0,5), (0,12), (0,14), (1,3), (1,6), (1,12), (1,14), (1,23),
    (2,19), (2,25), (3,14), (3,18), (4,21), (4,22), (6,11), (6,26),
    (7,9), (7,24), (8,12), (8,25), (9,11), (9,13), (9,19), (9,20),
    (9,31), (10,18), (10,19), (11,21), (12,16), (12,18), (12,28),
    (13,14), (13,24), (14,15), (14,18), (14,24), (15,16), (15,19),
    (17,22), (18,24), (19,27), (20,23), (21,27), (22,27), (23,31),
    (24,25), (25,31), (27,29), (27,30), (28,30)
]

for u, v in edges:
    s.add(color[u] != color[v])

# Check satisfiability
result = s.check()
print(result)
if result == sat:
    m = s.model()
    solution = [m.evaluate(color[i]).as_long() for i in range(32)]
    print(solution)
    # Verify
    ok = True
    for u,v in edges:
        if solution[u] == solution[v]:
            print(f"Conflict on edge ({u},{v})")
            ok = False
    print("Valid:", ok)
else:
    print("UNSAT")
